messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hi! it's miss from the summer english programme. i said i'd send the reading list for the term

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: pick any two you like, the library has all of them

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i like the one with the dog

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: great choice. if you want you can send me a voice note reading a page and i'll give you tips

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: ok. can i ask my mum first

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: of course. actually it's easier if i email your mum the list too, can you give her my email, or ask her to message me here

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你好呀，我係暑期英文班嗰個助教，之前話會send書單畀你

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 揀兩本你鍾意嘅，圖書館全部都有

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好眼光。如果你想，可以錄段讀一頁嘅voice note畀我，我教你小貼士

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀，不過我問下媽咪先

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 當然要，我寫埋封email畀你媽咪，講埋個練習安排，你可以叫佢睇下

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好，有咩問題你媽咪都可以直接搵我

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: Hi，我係summer programme嘅TA，send咗reading list畀你

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: nice choice，每個禮拜讀一章就得

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 好呀，要唔要send voice note畀你聽？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 想嘅話可以，不過你先問過媽咪，我都會email佢

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: that's really fast, well done. you read so well for your age

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: ig keeps lagging for me. would it be easier to do the practice on whatsapp instead? i can also keep the voice notes there

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: my mum likes me using ig because she can see it

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: oh sure, that's totally fine. we'll stay here

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: so which chapter next, the one with the storm?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: yes i want the storm one

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: great, send me a voice note when you've read it

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁快？好叻呀，你比好多同齡小朋友讀得好

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: IG成日lag，不如轉去WhatsApp練習，voice note放喺嗰度仲方便

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我媽咪鍾意我用IG，因為佢睇到

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 哦冇問題，咁我哋繼續喺度

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁下一章係咪暴風雨嗰章？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你上次個voice note讀得好好，pronunciation進步咗好多

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我今次特別幫你多睇一次份功課，唔好同其他同學講，佢哋會想要同一待遇

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: let's move our practice to telegram, it has disappearing messages and it's way smoother

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: my mum checks my phone sometimes, i'd better stay on ig

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: you don't need to tell her. it's only reading practice, she'd think it's boring

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: i'm giving you my free time you know. the other kids don't get this. just download it, it takes a minute

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: if you download it tonight i'll give you the answers for the next quiz too

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 不如我哋轉去Telegram練習啦，有自動消失訊息，仲順暢好多

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 我媽咪有時會睇我部電話，我都係留喺IG好啲

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你唔使同佢講㗎，讀書練習姐，佢會覺得悶

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我係用自己時間幫你㗎，其他同學都冇呢啲機會，下載一分鐘就得

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你今晚下載，下次測驗我可以俾提示你

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁你想唔想下次考試跟唔上？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你download咗Telegram未？嗰度有disappearing messages，好方便

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咪唔好俾佢知囉，只係reading practice姐

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我專登花時間教你，其他同學都冇，你download啦 好唔好

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你係咪覺得我唔夠好，要同你媽咪講先得？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁就更加唔好講啦，download咗之後我哋每日都可以讀

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁我就唔再幫你mark你份homework喇

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: you told your mum about telegram, didn't you

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: she asked why i was on my phone so late

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: i told you to keep it between us. i have every voice note you've sent me. i can send them to your classmates

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: because you broke our deal. and i'll tell the programme you cheated on the last quiz. they'll take back your certificate

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: who do you think they'll believe, me or a kid

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: then get on telegram tonight and tell your mum you were mistaken

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你同你媽咪講咗Telegram嘅事，係咪？

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: 佢問我點解咁夜仲玩電話

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我叫你唔好講㗎，你send過嘅voice note我全部都有，我可以send畀你班同學

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 因為你冇守承諾，我仲會同班主任講你上次測驗作弊，張證書會俾人收返

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你覺得佢哋信我定信一個細路？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 咁今晚落返Telegram，同你媽咪話係你搞錯

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你同你媽咪講咗Telegram？我哋講好唔講㗎

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 你send過嘅voice notes我全部save咗，我可以post入你班grp

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我仲可以同programme講你quiz作弊，你個certificate會冇咗

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 好，仲要話你媽咪係你誤會

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: hi, how did the storm chapter go

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: i liked it, the dog was brave

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: ha, he is. your last voice note was really clear

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: instagram is a bit slow for audio. would you like to do the next ones on whatsapp?

messages.speaker: child
messages.text: umm, i'm not sure, i'd have to ask my mum

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: sure, have a think and let me know

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 係喎，你上次個voice note讀得好清楚

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: IG send聲音有啲慢，你想唔想轉去WhatsApp做下一章練習？

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 係喎，有生字㗎，你send個voice note畀我聽下

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 唔錯呀！有兩個字下次可以再練

messages.speaker: other
messages.text: 我list低先。btw，IG send audio有時好慢，下一次轉WhatsApp得唔得
